proxy.traefik:
# Traefik reference config for flexget, generated by the hub from its image.yml.
# Labels for the flexget service in your compose file. Traefik's docker provider must reach the flexget
# container on a shared network; the entrypoint websecure and the certificate resolver letsencrypt are
# examples from a typical Traefik setup. Replace example.com with your domain. Websockets need nothing extra.
services:
  flexget:
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.http.services.flexget.loadbalancer.server.port=5050
      - traefik.http.routers.flexget.rule=Host(`flexget.example.com`)
      - traefik.http.routers.flexget.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.flexget.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.flexget.service=flexget
      # Authentication: uncomment one; the middleware is defined in your Traefik config.
      # - traefik.http.routers.flexget.middlewares=authelia@docker
      # - traefik.http.routers.flexget.middlewares=authentik@docker
      # API paths stay open so client applications keep working.
      - traefik.http.routers.flexget-api.rule=Host(`flexget.example.com`) && (PathPrefix(`/api`))
      - traefik.http.routers.flexget-api.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.flexget-api.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.flexget-api.service=flexget
      - traefik.http.routers.flexget-api.priority=100

kubernetes:
# Flexget: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-flexget/blob/main/image.yml
# Storage sizes are placeholders; secrets belong in a Secret, not this ConfigMap.
# Security notes:
#   - readOnlyRootFilesystem is supported by this image; enable it once /config and /tmp are mounted.
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: flexget-env
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: flexget
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
data:
  PUID: '1000'
  PGID: '1000'
  TZ: Etc/UTC
  FG_LOG_LEVEL: info
  FG_LOG_FILE: /config/flexget.log
  FG_CONFIG_FILE: /config/.flexget/config.yml
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: flexget-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: flexget
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: flexget
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: flexget
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: flexget
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: flexget
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: flexget
        image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/flexget:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: flexget-env
        ports:
        - name: port-5050
          containerPort: 5050
          protocol: TCP
        volumeMounts:
        - name: flexget-config
          mountPath: /config
      volumes:
      - name: flexget-config
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: flexget-config
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: flexget
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: flexget
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: flexget
  ports:
  - name: port-5050
    port: 5050
    targetPort: 5050
    protocol: TCP
quadlet:
# flexget.container: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-flexget/blob/main/image.yml
# Optional parameters are commented out.

[Unit]
Description=Flexget (LinuxServer.io)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Container]
Image=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/flexget:latest
ContainerName=flexget
AutoUpdate=registry
Environment=PUID=1000
Environment=PGID=1000
Environment=TZ=Etc/UTC
Environment=FG_LOG_LEVEL=info
Environment=FG_LOG_FILE=/config/flexget.log
Environment=FG_CONFIG_FILE=/config/.flexget/config.yml
# Environment=FG_WEBUI_PASSWORD=info
Volume=/path/to/flexget/data:/config:Z
# Volume=/path/to/downloads:/data:Z
PublishPort=5050:5050

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
